caption: The drawing shows a single metallic object placed against a plain, light-colored background. The object is circular and flattened, resembling a disc or rounded tank, with a smooth surface featuring subtle dents and highlights. On the upper side of the object are two raised elements: a cylindrical cap with a squared central fixture and hinge, and an adjacent round lid or cover that is slightly opened and appears hollow. The composition is executed in shades of graphite grey, using a stippling and shading technique to create the effect of three-dimensionality and the reflective, metallic quality of the surface. The object dominates the center of the drawing, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Hot Water Dish and Beaker
